wrong.why: The Nethanel named among the Levite chiefs as Conaniah's brother is nethanel-9, not the scribe nethanel-4.
The verse identifies Nethanel, the Levite chief under Josiah, as Conaniah's brother.

missing.why: The Hebrew names Shemaiah and Nethanel as Conaniah's brothers.

note: The missing Nethanel–Conaniah relationship is also supplied by the proposed retargeting of row 105632. Solomon's relationship to David is already recorded in other chapters.
